title: Concatenation of computation sequences
statement: For an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, an oracle language $O$, finite choice sequences $w,w'$, and a configuration $c$, running $N$ with $O$ on the concatenated sequence $w w'$ from $c$ gives the same configuration as first running it on $w$ from $c$ and then on $w'$ from the resulting configuration.
